title: Cranberry Sauce

adjustment.analysis: No events or promotions are scheduled. The price increase to $2.91 (+2.1%) is modest and within recent historical variation. Past promotions show no consistent uplift (noise-adjusted x1.0), and post-promotion dips are also noise-adjusted to x1.0. The heatwave (38°C) may reduce demand for cold, seasonal products like cranberry sauce, but no evidence shows this impact. Baseline trend is upward (55.6% 13-week trend), but already reflected. No drivers justify a multiplier shift. The classical model’s 1.0 is appropriate.

It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-81% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
